title: GO TO ... DEPENDING ON — branch table by 1-based numeric index; out-of-range falls through silently
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. DISPATCH.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-OPCODE   PIC 9.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
      *> GO TO ... DEPENDING ON: WS-OPCODE = 1 branches to STEP-A,
      *> 2 -> STEP-B, 3 -> STEP-C. WS-OPCODE outside [1,3] FALLS
      *> THROUGH to the statement after the GO TO. Modern Java
      *> needs a switch with explicit default.
           GO TO STEP-A STEP-B STEP-C DEPENDING ON WS-OPCODE.
           DISPLAY "unknown opcode"
           STOP RUN.
       STEP-A.
           DISPLAY "A".
           STOP RUN.
       STEP-B.
           DISPLAY "B".
           STOP RUN.
       STEP-C.
           DISPLAY "C".
           STOP RUN.
notes: GO TO DEPENDING ON is COBOL's computed GOTO. Same fall-through trap as the Fortran equivalent. A Java rewrite to switch is natural; the spec must surface the default branch as an explicit decision.
